items.title: Basse Area Council Gives D400,000 Boost to Complete Sutukonding Clinic
items.summary: By Dawda Baldeh The Basse Area Council has handed over a D400,000 (£4,500; $6,000) cheque to complete the construction of the Sutukonding Community Clinic, in a move set to transform basic healthcare access for more than 10 surrounding villages. The Council’s Chairperson, Maha...

items.summary: A campaign has been launched to halt the deportation of a Gambian DJ who has lived in Malta for 18 years, with organisations and prominent figures calling on the government to allow him to regularise his status. Yusupha Dibassey, better known as DJ Dollarino, was detained on 1...
